description: Declared observability (prompt 116): where each cataloged source can observe a kind, and above which thresholds. Used as the low-confidence 'declared' fallback when no empirical estimate exists; a descriptor's own 'observability' field wins. 'trackKinds' maps track kinds to the observability family whose presence proxy is estimated from the hourly rollups.
